g.text: Only irreversible labels such as [IP 01], [HOST 01], and [CAPTURE 01] are present.
No raw addresses, hostnames, case details, filenames, secrets, email addresses, local paths, or precise home location are embedded.
Continent → country → city aggregation keeps the whole traffic picture readable.
Protocol and time filters remain linked to the map
Complete identifiers remain readable while public documentation uses irreversible privacy labels.
